headline: Jung Seung Hwan to part ways with Antenna after 11 years
sub: His December solo concert will be his last with the agency
caption:
Ballad singer Jung Seung Hwan is leaving Antenna after 11 years.

Antenna said the two sides agreed, after long discussion, to end their partnership with his December solo concert, his 10th anniversary show 'Do You Like Ballads?'. "We sincerely support the new days ahead for Jung Seung Hwan," the agency said. He joined Antenna in 2015 after finishing runner-up on 'K-pop Star 4' and debuted in 2016.

📌 Source: Official statement from Antenna, via Korean media
